description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) used to specify filter parameters for searching actionable reviews within the orangehrmDashboardPlugin system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties such as employee numbers, reviewer numbers, status arrays, and include options, along with getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: ActionableReviewSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) that encapsulates filter parameters for searching actionable reviews, allowing filtering by employee, reviewer, statuses, and inclusion options within the Dashboard plugin.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter criterion (nullable integer).

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: getReviewerEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the reviewer employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setReviewerEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the reviewer employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the string indicating which employees to include in the search.

methods.name: getActionableStatuses
methods.description: Returns the array of statuses considered actionable filters.

methods.name: getSelfReviewStatuses
methods.description: Returns the array of self-review statuses.
